title: Frozen metric description
responsibility: Explains a measured value and the reviewed limit that applies without treating unavailable data as zero.

inputs.name: harnessBudget.finding
inputs.description: Optional budget finding supplying baseline, status and measured value.

inputs.name: harnessBudget.known
inputs.description: Optional reviewed-limit knowledge, defaulting to a declared freeze with no numeric limit.

outputs.name: harnessBudget
outputs.description: Value, limit and optional partial/growth note. Prefers the finding baseline over the ledger limit; otherwise distinguishes reviewed-unmeasurable, no value, merely declared freeze and no limit. Missing measurements and null values remain explicit.
